name: Report to Doren
summary: Corporal Sethman sends you to report the patrol findings to Lieutenant Doren. The rebels' commander receives them at Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Delivering the Intelligence
sections.body: Corporal Sethman wants you to give Lieutenant Doren a direct account of the patrol information. Bring back what you learned.

sections.title: A Traitor Revealed
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren learns that Merle betrayed the camp when you present the patrol information. He mourns a soldier he once believed brave and loyal. Yet he feels great relief that the traitor is found before Colonel Kurzen can take advantage.

faq.q: Who sends you to Lieutenant Doren?
faq.answer: Corporal Sethman sends you to Lieutenant Doren after reviewing the patrol schedules with you.

aliases: what is before report to doren
faq.answer: This follows Patrol Schedules, where Corporal Sethman reviews the patrol schedules with you.
You deliver the report to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
